register.labelZh: RING 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: RING 片語動詞可以說明你是致電一個人、聯絡多個地方、回覆來電、參與直播節目,還是透過內線聯絡另一個部門。；這些表達常見於酒店、學校、辦公室、診所、商店,以及電台或電視節目。；ring somebody up 表示致電某人;ring something up 則表示把貨品或交易輸入收銀機結帳。；ring out 可以描述鐘聲、人聲、音符、警告聲或歡呼聲清楚而響亮地傳開。
register.summaryEn: RING expressions can show whether you contacted one person, called several places, returned a call, joined a live programme or contacted another department. These expressions commonly appear in hotels, schools, offices, clinics, shops and radio or television programmes. Ring somebody up means to telephone somebody. Ring something up means to enter a purchase on a till. Ring out can describe a bell, voice, musical note, warning or cheer that is heard loudly and clearly.
